svg.text: The brig's rigging plan (N3.2): 190 lines, 87 standing and 103 running, and the ways aloft

Side view. Black: standing rigging. Running rigging by what it does: red braces, blue halliards and outhauls, orange sheets and tacks, green clewlines, buntlines and reef tackles, violet lifts and vangs.
Green bands: the surfaces aloft the walk graph reaches (tops, crosstrees, footropes, bowsprit). Each running line ends on its own pin at the rail.
